title: Make tmx mutant generation deterministic and digest-pinned (DEC-195 (3))
description: Before any score is used for acceptance, tmx's mutant generation must be deterministic: sorted inputs, seeded, and a mutant-set digest written beside each score. Today two builds of the same source disagree by about 5 mutants (the fresh critical-tier matrix has 418 mutants vs the committed 412, entirely gate.py 205->211, with no source change), so a score cannot be compared across builds. Prove it both ways: two builds of 127461d give the same digest, and a one-line gate.py change moves it. Cited by TS-11 AC0 acceptance.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The same commit and seed produce the same mutant set: tmx sorts its inputs, uses a seeded generator, and records a mutant-set digest beside each score.
Proved both ways: two builds of 127461d give the same digest, and a one-line change to gate.py changes it.

finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/test-skills#23. AC1 and AC2 were checked against evidence, and one Stage 1 review round was addressed before this summary was finalized. Implementation: build_specs takes a seed, recorded in tool.seed and used by the per-line sample; the file walk is de-duplicated and sorted, the extra-mutant list is sorted, and per-line groups are visited in sorted order; the collector writes mutants_digest, a sha256 over the sorted unique mutant keys, which the collector summary, score and analyze print. The digest covers the mutant set (file, line, operator, description), not the rendered mutant bodies, so it is interpreter-stable. Evidence for AC1: gate.py at commit 127461db built twice gave mutants=452 and digest db730c206c676774a9e82248d1015832c1a5f43e30b2a623461ae59a420de2df both times, and the same digest under Python 3.9.6 and 3.12.13; an end-to-end two-run collect on a small project produced the same digest in both matrices with tool.seed 0, and a --history collect completed with a history mutant instead of crashing. Evidence for AC2: a one-line change to that same gate.py left the mutant count at 452 and moved the digest to 5b9cda097562a56f76fd0006d217fbb9f85bd61c088ab6ad597eca2ddc2ea546. Review round 1 returned changes requested: the history path crashed, the digest depended on the interpreter, and the test did not exercise the mechanism; all three were fixed on the branch in commit b357260. No new test case was added because the suite sits at its max_tests ceiling of 79; the determinism assertions ride the existing mutant test. lore check reports 11 schema-drift errors on this branch and the identical 26 files and 11 errors on untouched origin/dev, so the drift predates this change; no lore schema export was run.
